options.text: Verify emergency stop and safety interlocks are operational
Wipe exterior paint with damp cloth

viva_quiz.explanation: Emergency stop functional checks ensure machinery can be halted instantly in the event of operator entanglement.

viva_quiz.question_en: How frequently should measuring instrument zero-point calibration be verified on the shopfloor?
viva_quiz.question_hi: शॉपफ्लोर पर मापने वाले उपकरण के शून्य-बिंदु अंशांकन की कितनी बार पुष्टि की जानी चाहिए?
viva_quiz.explanation: Pre-shift zero-checks prevent batch calibration drift and ensure dimensional tolerances adhere to ISO 9001 standards.

viva_quiz.question_en: When a quality non-conformance is detected, what is the mandatory containment action?
viva_quiz.question_hi: जब गुणवत्ता गैर-अनुरूपता का पता चलता है, तो अनिवार्य रोकथाम कार्रवाई क्या है?

options.text: Quarantine affected workpiece to designated containment area and log defect ID
Ship the defective piece to the customer
Hide the workpiece in tool locker

viva_quiz.explanation: Immediate quarantine prevents defective parts from progressing downstream in the manufacturing line.

pro_tips: Verify calibration log certificate date (<90 days) before initiating Custom Seed Preparation in Paddy Processing & Treatment Kiosk sequence.
Maintain standardized station lighting (>300 Lux) and ergonomic tool posture to minimize operator fatigue.
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Bypassing pre-shift zero-point check on precision digital measurement gauges.
Applying excessive mechanical force instead of allowing calibrated torque / thermal dwell time.
study_takeaways.statutory_safety_rule: MANDATORY: Follow OSHA 1910.147 / CEA Safety Regulations: Zero-energy state and mandatory PPE must be verified before internal mechanism access.
